units.source_text: 薰中将则不然，他对世俗生活深感乏味，

en.t: Kaoru Chujo was different; he felt a deep weariness with worldly life,

units.source_text: 心念如果草草地爱上一个女人，身上便有了一种不可割离的羁绊，

en.t: thinking that if he carelessly fell in love with a woman, he would acquire a bond that could not be severed,

units.source_text: 此种自讨烦恼之事，还是避免的好。

en.t: and that it was better to avoid such self-inflicted trouble.

units.source_text: 因此把婚姻之事完全丢开。

en.t: For this reason, he put the matter of marriage entirely aside.

units.source_text: 也许是因为难觅称心之人，所以故作贤明之态，亦未可知。

en.t: Perhaps, unable to find anyone who truly pleased him, he was merely pretending to be wise; that too is possible.

units.source_text: 然而招人物议的色情之事，他毕竟不干。

en.t: Yet he never engaged in amorous affairs that would invite public criticism.

units.source_text: 他在十九岁上受任为三位宰相，仍兼中将之职。

en.t: At the age of nineteen, he was appointed a councillor of the third rank, while still holding the post of middle captain.

units.source_text: 他受冷泉院与秋好皇后优遇，位极人臣，可谓尊荣无比了。

en.t: Favored by Reizei-in and Empress Akikonomu, he rose to the highest rank a subject could attain, and his honor was unsurpassed.

units.source_text: 然而心中怀着一个身世根本问题，常常闷闷不乐。

en.t: Even so, he carried in his heart a fundamental question about his birth, and was often gloomy and unhappy.

units.source_text: 所以一向不曾任情寻花问柳，平居总是沉默寡言，世人自然都称道他是个老成持重的人。

en.t: Thus he had never given himself over to casual love affairs; in daily life he was always quiet and reserved, and people naturally praised him as mature and prudent.
